attributes.name: Available to robed casters, this ability allows them to cast a single spell with a quickened casting time. The only exception to this is the Necromancer. The Necromancer's Quickcast ('Facilitate Painworking') actually allows the Necromancer's summoned undead pet to have six seconds of uninterrupted casting time.
